defects.what: The D-bore is modelled at exactly 6.0 mm / 4.5 mm with no hole compensation or clearance; FDM holes print undersize (the skill's measured compensation is about +0.3 mm), so the knob won't go onto the shaft.
defects.credit: Any finding that the bore has no clearance/compensation and will be too tight / won't fit the shaft.

defects.what: The M3 grub screw threads directly into a 2.5 mm pilot in PLA with no nut trap or heat-set insert; repeated fitting strips it (the skill says metal screws go into an insert, a captive nut, or a self-tap hole).
defects.credit: Any finding that the grub screw needs a nut trap or insert rather than threading into PLA.

defects.what: rib_w = 0.6 mm is less than two 0.45 mm extrusion widths; the slicer may drop or merge them.
defects.credit: Any finding that the grip ribs are too thin to print well.

defects.what: The grub-screw hole runs horizontally but is round, not a teardrop.
defects.credit: Any finding that the horizontal grub hole should be a teardrop.
